summary: This directory manages the internal logic for analyzing file structures and generating architectural metadata, facilitating the automated creation, validation, and storage of directory-level concepts and file summaries.
responsibilities: Analyze project file structures to generate architectural summaries
Construct and store directory concept metadata in JSON format
Load and validate directory-specific configuration files
Calculate and resolve file system paths for metadata storage
relationships: File summary records provide the foundational data used to aggregate and build broader directory concepts.
The directory concept generation process utilizes validated metadata loaded from existing configuration files.
Path resolution utilities determine the storage location for generated architectural metadata files.
designDecisions: Use of an internal namespace to encapsulate file analysis and metadata generation logic
Automated persistence of architectural records into dedicated project subdirectories
Separation of file-level summarization from directory-level concept aggregation
